240-955-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
240-955-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2393-4279-7286--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2393-4279-7286--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar, Sifter of Skulls and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life. Its second ability then triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

441-687-2034.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three counters on Kinsbaile Borderguard.
441-687-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kinsbaile Borderguard, adding {C}{C}.
When Kinsbaile Borderguard dies, its last ability triggers, creating three Kithkin Soldier tokens that each enter with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three vigilance counters from creatures you control, milling yourself three cards and returning Kinsbaile Borderguard from your graveyard to the battlefield. Kinsbaile Borderguard enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam and at least three +1/+1 counters due to its first ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing a Kithkin Soldier and Kinsbaile Borderguard, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Kinsbaile Borderguard dies, its last ability triggers, creating four Kithkin Soldier tokens that each enter with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times, increasing the number of +1/+1 counters and tokens each time.
441-687-2034.notes: This order of operations and the {1} starting mana are necessary because you must activate mana abilities like Ashnod's Altar's before paying the counter removal cost.

833-3827-3861-5607.notablePrerequisites: Soul of Windgrace and Klauth can attack without taking damage.
833-3827-3861-5607.description:
Declare Klauth and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Klauth and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Klauth trigger, adding at least nine mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Orzhov Basilica, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

4050-5544-6822-7920.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lyla trigger.
Repeat.

456-1636-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
456-1636-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Manaform Hellkite triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2724-3987-7715.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Mighty Thor. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

108-3055-3953-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Eyeless Watcher, adding {W}.
When Eyeless Watcher dies, Mazzy's second ability and Gift of Immortality trigger.
Resolve the Mazzy trigger, exiling Gift of Immortality with the ability to cast it until end of your next turn.
Resolve the Gift of Immortality trigger, returning Eyeless Watcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eyeless Watcher enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate two creature tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Gift of Immortality from exile by paying {2}{W}, attaching it to Eyeless Watcher.
Repeat.

2921-6461--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat

112-6573-7426.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone three times this game.
112-6573-7426.description:
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to Font of Magic, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat.

141-3967-7449.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-3967-7449.description:
Cast Stir the Grave by paying {4}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Stir the Grave.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Stir the Grave
Resolve the Stir the Grave copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

215-3464-6479.description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-2557-3257-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2557-3257-3875-4231.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Parallel Lives.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1563-1903-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1563-1903-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2464-2836-3832.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2464-2836-3832.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-2836-3832.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck is empty
Draw a card, causing you to win the game due to Laboratory Maniac.

5282-5399-7149.description:
Cast Pirated Copy by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Pirated Copy into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Pirated Copy dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Pirated Copy enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Pirated Copy leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Pirated Copy from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-6529-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-6529-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Curse of the Restless Dead and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1563-2457-4365-6965.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

593-4083-6899.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Mogg Maniac.
Mogg Maniac is indestructible.
593-4083-6899.description:
Deal damage to Mogg Maniac.
Mogg Maniac and Repercussion trigger.
Resolve the Mogg Maniac trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Mogg Maniac instead of you due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.

339-647-677-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1680-3767-3918-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1680-3767-3918-4002.description:
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

869-1987-4423-5116.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus by tapping them, adding {3}{U}
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Gilded Lotus.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

789-997-2399--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-997-2399--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Woe Strider by sacrificing that creature.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Ooze.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider abilities, scrying 1 each time.
Repeat.
789-997-2399--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

1479-3478-6754.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Eusocial Engineering, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Eusocial Engineering trigger, creating a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Eusocial Engineering trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

4222-4474-6210.easyPrerequisites: Neerdiv does not have summoning sickness.
4222-4474-6210.description:
Activate Neerdiv by tapping it, adding {U}.
Neerdiv triggers, causing a player to mill cards equal to its power.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Neerdiv.
Repeat.

uses.n: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting

11-5257-6070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Doctors.
11-5257-6070.description:
Cast Twice Upon a Time by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Twice Upon a Time.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Twice Upon a Time, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Twice Upon a Time and returning the original Twice Upon a Time to your hand.
Resolve Twice Upon a Time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-5257-6070.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

1170-2792-6060.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{W}{W}.
1170-2792-6060.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{W}{W}.
Cast Forced Worship by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Great Whale.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Forced Worship spell.
Activate Forced Worship by paying {2}{W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2760-4279-5332.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
2760-4279-5332.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1170-4808-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4808-5131.description:
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha.
Repeat.

703-1251-2751-2972.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's ability, targeting Strionic Resonator.
Resolve the copy of Astral Dragon's ability, creating two token copies of Strionic Resonator that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
When the Strionic Resonator tokens enter the battlefield, Ganax triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate a Strionic Resonator copy by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Astral Dragon's ability from step 2.
Repeat from step 6.

1693-3750-4711-4813.notablePrerequisites:
Famished Foragers does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two opponents.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Famished Foragers.
 An opponent has lost life this turn.
1693-3750-4711-4813.description:
Declare Famished Foragers as an attacker.
Famished Foragers' myriad ability triggers, creating at least two token copies of it that are tapped and attacking.
The Famished Foragers tokens enter the battlefield, adding at least six {R}.
At the end of your combat phase, Blade of Selves triggers, exiling the Famished Foragers tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of red mana, if you have a card in hand, you may activate Famished Foragers' ability to rummage infinitely.

1242-1424-2744.notablePrerequisites:
Presence of Gond attached to Cinderhaze Wretch.
Cinderhaze Wretch does not have summoning sickness.
1242-1424-2744.description:
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
The Elf Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

2034-5003-5221.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sprouting Thrinax, adding {C}{C}.
When Sprouting Thrinax dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Sprouting Thrinax from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2034-3866-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Abhorrent Overlord.
When Abhorrent Overlord enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

538-1183-1636-4061.notablePrerequisites:
Dalakos does not have summoning sickness.
Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters.
538-1183-1636-4061.description:
Activate Dalakos by tapping it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent on artifacts or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Creature tokens enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.
